items.note: Title suggests a study of creativity growth from hybrid AI-human ideation in college programs (included in Shi 2026 meta-analysis); abstract not reachable via OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, Europe PMC, PsycNet or web search, so design, N and outcomes need the full text.

Experiment in which participants generate, select and refine patent-based product ideas with LLM assistance at manipulated hallucination levels (one AI configuration versus another), scoring originality, diversity, elaboration and feasibility; assignment method and N not in the abstract.

Quasi-experiment (per search notes) with 100 visual communication design students in traditional, chatbot-assisted and fully integrated AIGC book-design course conditions, with design product performance plus self-efficacy outcomes; abstract not reachable (Springer paywall, no API abstract), so whether creativity is scored on the designs needs the full text.

Compares traditional versus ChatGPT-assisted inquiry-based learning with 462 Taiwanese high-school students (ANCOVA, PLS-SEM) and reports limited effects on creativity; the task is not a creative task and the creativity measure is likely a survey scale, so this may be out as self_report_only after the full text.

Controlled collective word-guessing task comparing human-only, AI-only and hybrid human-AI groups on performance and diversity of guesses; the task is only partly creative and the assignment method and N (search snippet suggests 50, 46, 28 humans) are not in the abstract.

Randomized experiment with 435 participants in 122 teams (human-only, one-AI and multiple-AI teams, plus individual-AI pairs) on content-generation and innovation tasks; outcomes are general performance measures, so whether creativity or quality of ideas is scored needs the full text; SSRN version 10.2139/ssrn.4844976 is the same study.

Randomized experiment with 112 college students comparing AI-first, AI-follow, AI-parallel and human-only collaboration on a two-stage story-writing task, with creativity rated by 10 trained raters and an AI model; sequential AI collaboration lowered narrative creativity (Research Square preprint).

Counterbalanced within-subjects experiment with 32 design students comparing a text-and-image AI workflow with human-only brainstorming on one design brief, with outputs scored by three expert raters; below 50 participants and order randomization not stated.

Title indicates a comparison of AIGC-based and traditional idea generation methods on creativity in product design ideation (cited in Peng 2025 and Ozkan 2026 meta-analyses); abstract not reachable via OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, Europe PMC, ScienceDirect or web search, so design and N need the full text.

CHI 2025 system paper (Inkspire, sketch-driven text-to-image tool) with a within-subjects study comparing it to ControlNet (one AI configuration versus another); outcomes described as inspiration and exploration, possibly self-reported, and N not in the abstract; arXiv 2501.18588 is the same work.
